sites.name: Linux Foundation training
sites.interaction: A catalogue of certifications.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: We are free and sequential, not a cert shop. Do not add a price card, a seat counter, or a 'cohort starts Monday' banner.

sites.name: KodeKloud
sites.interaction: DevOps courses, labs, a path UI.
sites.mobile: Labs are the hard mobile problem.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Labs are future work. The visual system should not pretend a terminal is running. Projects can look like artifacts later. This pass does not fake a shell.

sites.name: Killercoda
sites.interaction: Browser labs.
sites.performance: Heavy and justified, because it is the product.
sites.mobile: A terminal on a phone is miserable. They still try.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Do not put a fake terminal on the homepage to look like engineering. Engineering is the content of later days.

sites.name: OverTheWire
sites.interaction: SSH war games. The site is ugly and perfect.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Ugly and clear beats pretty and lost. The constellation gets a legend. Planned days are visibly planned.

sites.name: Bandit
sites.interaction: Level by level. You cannot skip the idea even if you skip ahead.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Sequential does not mean visually locked. Future days are visible and dormant, not hidden. That is more honest than a war game, and it matches the published/planned flags.

sites.name: Explainshell
sites.interaction: You paste a command, it annotates every token.
sites.space: A line of type, broken apart.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Breaking a line into meaningful pieces is the kinetic type we want. We break on words, and the words mean the title, not a shell pipeline.

sites.name: Explain xkcd is wrong reference
sites.interaction: Annotations of comics. A wiki.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Do not annotate the homepage with footnotes. The instrument does not get a caption paragraph. The lock does.

sites.name: Wait But Why
sites.interaction: Very long essays, stick figures, no chrome.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Length is not immersion. Our scroll length is the camera score (desktop ~280vh), then a normal page. Not a 40,000-word essay.

sites.name: The Pudding stories
sites.interaction: Their process notes. How a visual essay is made.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Process: one visual system, reused, not a new chart type per section. data-world is that reuse.

sites.name: NYT You Draw It
sites.interaction: You draw a guess, then the line reveals. Famous and old. URL is the known 2017 piece.
sites.motion: The reveal of the true line.
sites.mobile: Drawing with a finger is the interaction.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: We do not ask the visitor to guess. The only 'you were wrong' we allow is empty progress: the net stays dark until you complete a day.

sites.name: NYT dialect quiz
sites.interaction: Questions, then a map of you.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: No quiz in the hero. No 'what kind of engineer are you'. The path is the same for everyone. Progress is the only personalization.

sites.name: Spotify.design
sites.interaction: A design team's site. Case studies, motion as brand.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: A design-team site is still a portfolio. We are not collecting case studies in the hero.

sites.name: Stripe Press
sites.interaction: Books. A quiet, confident shop.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: About can be this quiet later. The homepage is not a bookshop. No jacket grid.

sites.name: The Browser Company
sites.interaction: Arc's company site, essay-like, product as culture.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Culture essays are not the first 30 seconds. The first 30 seconds are the instrument waking up.

sites.name: Linear method
sites.interaction: A principles page. Writing, not a scene.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Principles live in this markdown, not as a manifesto section above the fold. The fold is the system.

sites.name: Vercel ship
sites.interaction: A conference brand. Dark, grid, type.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Poster type in a grid is now a cliché of developer events. Our serif is older and quieter than that grid. No neon grid.

sites.name: Raycast store
sites.interaction: A grid of extensions. The store, not the homepage.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: The destinations section can stay a list of places to go. It should not become the visual identity. Noted so we do not spend this pass redesigning the footer of the homepage while the hero is wrong.

sites.name: Notion templates
sites.interaction: A marketplace of pages.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Template galleries are card grids. Our phases are not templates you duplicate. They are states of one programme.

sites.name: Figma community
sites.interaction: Files you duplicate.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Same warning. Community grids are not the journey.

sites.name: Are.na channels
sites.interaction: Explore as wandering.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Explore in our header is a short menu of real routes, not an infinite wander. The name 'Explore' is already a risk. The menu stays a menu.

sites.name: Obsidian graph
sites.interaction: The feature page for the graph, if present, or the product's graph docs. The idea is the hairball.
sites.mobile: The graph is optional on mobile.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: We do not simulate forces on 120 nodes. Positions are deterministic (the constellation already does this) so hydration matches and the picture is stable.

sites.name: Roam Research
sites.interaction: Bidirectional links as the product.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Backlinks are not our model. Days belong to one phase. The net connects phases in a fixed way, not in a user-authored tangle.

sites.name: Logseq
sites.interaction: Local-first outliner.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Local-first, again. Worth a second row only because the homepage of a local-first tool is still a download page. Ours is the tool's front door, and the data stays in local progress.

sites.name: RemNote
sites.interaction: Notes plus flashcards.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Do not add flashcards to the visual system. Out of product scope. Named to close the door.

sites.name: Craft
sites.interaction: A beautiful document app. Marketing is soft and premium.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Premium calm is easy to confuse with our calm. Theirs is a document app selling paper. Ours is geometry. If the homepage feels like Craft, it has become an editorial site again.

sites.name: Things
sites.interaction: A to-do app sold with enormous product shots and almost no words.
sites.motion: The product UI is the film.
sites.typography: Almost none. The UI is the type.
sites.mobile: The shots are the mobile site.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: Few words, the object is the product. That is the hero rule, translated: the sentence can be short because the system is showing you the path.

sites.name: Linear changelog
sites.interaction: A log. Quiet, respected.
sites.lessonForTheAiRishi: We do not need a fake changelog in the hero. Shipping is the git history. The site shows the programme, not our commit messages.
